about.description: Forex perpetual market on Ondo Perps tracking US Dollar / Japanese Yen, cash-settled, 24/7, up to 10x leverage, margined in USDC, hourly funding. Users get linear price exposure only - no delivery of the underlying currencies. Adapter snapshot 2026-09-21: mark $157.298, open interest $35.87K, 24h volume $16.40K. Added 2026-09-21 in the third Ondo Perps expansion batch, taking the registry from 45 to 56 RWA markets; the adapter's 65 live rows include 9 crypto perps (BTC, ENA, ETH, HYPE, ONDO, PUMP, SOL, XRP, ZEC) that are out of scope.
